claim: Q4 financial results show operating profit surging over 100% YoY, but management announces intentional investment cycle in high-quality merchants and logistics
Temu accelerates semi-managed model onboarding in US/EU, shifting fulfillment to local warehouses and mitigating small-package customs scrutiny
Domestic e-commerce price competition intensifies as incumbent platforms expand free merchant refunds and subsidize freight insurance

Q3 2026 consolidated revenue stalled at RMB 108,341M (+0.06% YoY; Transaction Services -11.7% YoY post-EU €3 duty and US CBP postal de minimis suspension) while Online Marketing grew +12.1% YoY vs Alibaba China -5% and S&M cuts (-16.6% YoY) lifted GAAP operating profit +24.5% YoY to RMB 31,164M (28.8% OPM); 9M GAAP net income fell -7.4% YoY, financing CF was <RMB 1M (zero buybacks/dividends), FY2025 20-F Note 15 revealed -RMB 6.12B Non-PRC PBT loss, 2026 HNTE expirations (RMB 9.60B FY25 benefit), and RMB 45.99M Cayman HoldCo cash vs RMB 232.57B in VIE, and EC issued Nov 17 DSA Art. 35 preliminary breach findings after May 28 €200M fine [confirm pass 80% on 20-F + direct press release/EC verification]
